capabilities: Annotate every sentence with automatic Jyutping
Look up words in an embedded 31k-entry dictionary with Jyutping, pinyin and English gloss
Play, loop and speed-control individual sentences with transcript search
Review vocabulary with spaced repetition and a mistake notebook
Practice shadowing with a coverage score and track listening comprehension
extras: Desktop only; local Python is used for the optional ASR and TTS add-ons. Feeds, transcripts, stats and notes stay in the vault, with no telemetry or account.
problem: Cantonese podcast audio rarely comes with transcripts or romanization, so learners cannot look up words, replay single sentences, or review what they heard.

relations.evidence: set up optional local ASR (sherpa-onnx SenseVoice)

summary: Cantonese podcast study tool with automatic Jyutping, word lookup, sentence playback, shadowing, spaced repetition and listening stats.
